title: Traffic Management Office (TMO) Clearance / Certification
description: Get a certification from the Dipolog City Traffic Management Office that you have no pending traffic case or violation.
department: City Mayor's Office – Traffic Management Division (TMO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.

items: Official receipt for the certification fee (City Treasurer's Office)

procedures.clientAction: Pay the TMO certification fee at the City Treasurer's Office cashier.
procedures.providerAction: Accept payment and issue the official receipt.

procedures.clientAction: Present the official receipt to the TMO admin staff.
procedures.providerAction: Check the database for pending or unpaid traffic violations. If there is a pending violation, the applicant must settle it first before the certification can be issued.

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 15 minutes.

reference.title: City of Dipolog Citizen's Charter 2022 (1st Edition)

title: Settlement of Traffic Ordinance Violations
description: Settle a traffic citation issued in Dipolog City, including what to do if you lost your citation ticket.
department: City Mayor's Office – Traffic Management Division (TMO)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.

items: Citation ticket, or court order / court subpoena
Name of the violator and the vehicle plate number (given to the TMO admin staff)

procedures.clientAction: Go to the Traffic Management Office (TMO) within seven (7) days from apprehension and present the citation ticket or subpoena. (Lost ticket: give the violator's name and plate number.)
procedures.providerAction: Review the ticket (or look up the violation in the database) and compute the fines.

procedures.clientAction: Pay the fines at the Cashier, City Treasurer's Office.
procedures.providerAction: Review the ticket or assessment, accept payment and issue the official receipt.
procedures.fee: Based on the traffic violation; see the schedule of penalties

procedures.clientAction: Return to the TMO and present the official receipt.
procedures.providerAction: Record the payment in the database. For a court order or subpoena, the client is advised to proceed to the Bulwagan ng Katarungan.

reference.title: City of Dipolog Citizen's Charter 2022 (1st Edition)

title: Renewal of Motorized Tricycle Operator's Permit (MTOP)
description: Renew the Motorized Tricycle Operator's Permit required by the LTO to operate a tricycle as public conveyance within Dipolog City.
department: City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division (BPLD)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Any motorized tricycle operator or driver recognized as a member of a registered Tricycle Operators and Drivers Association (TODA), who is a resident of Dipolog City and wishes to operate a tricycle unit within the city

items: Accomplished application form, original (CMO – Permits & License Division)
Previous Motorized Tricycle Operator's Permit (MTOP), original
Barangay Clearance, original (barangay where the operator resides)
Driver's License / Certificate of Appearance, original

procedures.clientAction: Submit all requirements for MTOP renewal to BPLD (Window 7).
procedures.providerAction: Receive and check the documents and prepare the order of payment; inspect the motorcycle unit.
Accept payment and issue the official receipt.
Print the MTOP, have it signed by the Head of BPLD and approved by the City Administrator, then release it with the receipt.
procedures.duration: About 40 minutes (approval by the City Administrator is listed at 30 minutes)
procedures.personInCharge: BPLD staff / Head, BPLD / City Administrator

contact.location: Business Permit & License Division, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall, Rizal Ave.

notes: The MTOP must be renewed based on the renewal of the motorcycle's plate number with the LTO.
Total processing time per the Charter: 1 hour.
The Charter also covers transfer of ownership (₱910.00), substitution of unit (₱100.00 plus ₱100.00 for re-issuance) and dropping of an MTOP (₱100.00). Ask BPLD for those requirements.

reference.title: City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division Citizen's Charter (posted September 2023)
